name: Seeking Revenge
overview: Scripture firmly instructs believers to reject personal vengeance and instead embody love and forgiveness, as God commands us to love our neighbors and not bear grudges (Leviticus 19:18). Vengeance belongs to the Lord alone, who will enact justice in His timing (Deuteronomy 32:35), so we are called to patiently trust Him rather than repay evil ourselves (Proverbs 20:22). Jesus further teaches us to forgive others so that we may receive forgiveness from our Father in heaven (Mark 11:25) and to treat others as we desire to be treated (Luke 6:31), even extending love beyond our friends to our enemies (Matthew 5:43).
